name: Astera.fi
rootCause: Astera.fi on Linea was reported exploited on 2025-10-09. The public record splits between incorrect share accounting with $573,000 in losses and a second narrative that describes a liquidity-index or oracle manipulation path with a larger loss estimate. The exact root cause is unresolved. Public sources conflict between incorrect share accounting and a liquidity index or oracle manipulation path, and no fetched primary post-mortem or historical code excerpt establishes which invariant failed.
